## Type

- [ ] `feat`     — new feature
- [ ] `fix`      — bug fix
- [ ] `library`  — new or updated library source
- [ ] `contract` — contract amendment
- [ ] `docs`     — documentation only
- [ ] `chore`    — tooling, CI, deps

## Checklist

- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes locally
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] If library entry: triple-verification recorded in the entry's front-matter
- [ ] If contract amendment: at least one library source cited
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or tokens in the diff
